<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<shape id="w" shape="path" width="200" height="10" x="220" y="180" path="M 0 5 L 200 5" stroke="#FF0000FF" strokeWidth="3" fill="#00000000"><shapeModifier type="wiggle-path" size="8" detail="10" frequency="2" seed="7" mode="smooth"/></shape>
</composition>
</scene>

expected.pending: the SREP states no pixel-level expectation: the wiggled points come from the engine's seeded noise, so no centroid or size can be computed analytically; its check compares vertices and turn angles of smooth against corner, which the kit's colour-centroid measure cannot express
